title: Senior Executive - Customer Experience/Insight
description:
We are looking for a detail\-oriented and analytical professional to support the Voice of Customer (VoC) function through structured research, feedback analysis, and insight generation. The role requires strong data interpretation skills, understanding of customer experience in BFSI technology environments, and the ability to derive actionable insights from customer interactions. The individual will primarily focus on backend analysis while providing support during customer interactions and discussions.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Analyze customer feedback collected through VoC interactions, surveys, and discussions to identify trends, themes, and key insights
* Support preparation of pre\-meeting research dossiers, including customer background, engagement history, and product usage insights
* Assist in structuring questionnaires and feedback frameworks aligned with VoC objectives
* Participate in customer meetings as a support resource, capturing detailed notes and observations
* Convert qualitative and quantitative feedback into structured reports and dashboards
* Highlight key pain points, improvement areas, and potential risks based on analysis
* Ensure accuracy and consistency in data interpretation and reporting
* Maintain and publish periodic VoC reports, summaries, and insights for leadership review
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders (Customer Success, Product, Delivery) to validate findings and ensure contextual relevance
* Continuously enhance analytical frameworks, reporting quality, and turnaround time


**Requirements**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail
* Basic to fair understanding of BFSI lending lifecycle and enterprise software environments
* Ability to synthesize large volumes of data into meaningful insights
* Good written and verbal communication skills
* Proficiency in tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, and data visualization platforms
* High ownership and accountability in managing deliverables
* Ability to work independently in a flat structure with minimal supervision
* Openness to learning and understanding product ecosystems (e.g., lending platforms like FinnOne Neo)


**Benefits**
 Nucleus is well known for identifying, nurturing, and promoting the internal talent and having long mutually rewarding associations with its performing associates. Our focus programs help our associates to continuously grow based on their capability, performance, and career aspirations.

title: Process Lead ICX
description:
Position: Process Lead ICX
   

  

 Location: Remote
   

  

 Role Purpose \& Overview:
   

  

 Drive a customer\-centric, quality\-focused operating model by using Voice of Customer (VoC) insights. Reduce customer effort, improve experience, and deliver meaningful outcomes beyond internal metrics. Act as the voice of the customer within operations, identifying gaps in existing processes and systems and transforming them into customer\-focused solutions. Bridge customer insights with business execution to enable continuous improvement in both customer experience and overall business performance.
   

  

 Key responsibilities:
   

  

* Collect, analyze, and interpret Voice of Customer (VoC) Insights \& Actioning (DSAT, repeats, blocking issues, cancellations)
* Identify top customer problems and friction areas and Translate insights into actionable improvements
* Review existing processes and systems to identify where policies or workflows that do not align with customer needs or expectations
* Redesign or recommend improvements to: Simplify customer journeys / Reduce effort and repeat contacts
* Evaluate internal tools and systems from a customer lens and drive improvements to ensure tools enable better customer interactions
* Monitor key indicators – Cancellations/ DSAT’s / Repeats / Compliance and drive improvement through feedback and recommendations
* Cross collaboration with different teams (Delivery/ Training/ Quality)
* Understand various business lines, goals and problems. Identify trends and generate reports to uncover opportunities for improvement


 Role prerequisites:
   

  

* Strong data\-driven approach with the ability to analyze complex datasets, derive insights, and translate them into actionable business improvements
* 2\+ years of relevant experience in customer experience (CX), operations, or process improvement, demonstrating solid domain expertise
* Good understanding of process mapping, process re\-engineering, and continuous improvement methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma preferred)
* Proven ability to identify customer problems and translate insights into practical, scalable solutions
* Experience evaluating and improving workflows, policies, and systems with a customer\-centric approach
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with keen attention to detail and root cause identification
* Proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools (e.g., Excel, SQL, dashboards, or BI tools like Power BI/Tableau) preferred
* Strong communication skills with the ability to clearly present insights, recommendations, and cases

title: Research Coordinator
description:
**Call for Applications: Research Coordinator – 13\-Month Paid In\-Person Internship (Immediate Joining)** 




**Position:** 
 Research Coordinator (Intern)
 



**Duration:** 
 13 Months
 



**Mode:** 
 In\-Person Only
 



**Location:** 
 Noida (Delhi NCR)
 



**Monthly Stipend:** 
**₹10,000** 




**Performance\-Based Completion Incentive:** 
**Up to ₹3,500 per month** 
 , payable as a
 **lump sum upon successful completion of the 13\-month internship** 
 , based on the intern's overall performance.
 



**Joining:** 
 Immediate
 



**Application Deadline:** 
**18 September, 2026** 




  





 About GCTC
 



 The Global Counter Terrorism Council (GCTC) is a premier international think tank focused on shaping global policy and strategic responses to contemporary challenges in counterterrorism, national security, and international relations.
 



 Founded with the mission to promote peace, security, and stability in the global order, GCTC works to build collaborations between governments, policy experts, civil society, and private sectors. Known for its research\-driven approach, GCTC offers data\-backed insights, policy recommendations, and innovative solutions to some of the world's most pressing security and governance challenges.
 



 Beyond counterterrorism, GCTC organizes high\-level conferences and strategic dialogues on emerging technologies, sustainable development, diplomacy, and public policy, facilitating capacity building and cross\-sectoral partnerships.
 



  





 Mission of GCTC
 


* Advance India's leadership in counter\-terrorism, governance reform, and digital sovereignty.
* Serve as a bridge between policymakers, academia, youth, industry, and civil society.
* Generate actionable knowledge through policy dialogues, white papers, and strategic consultations.
* Support India's role in shaping a secure, inclusive, and technologically advanced global order.



 Impact of GCTC So Far
 



 ✅
 **350\+** 
 National and International Conferences Convened
 



 🧾
 **750\+** 
 Policy Reports and Strategic White Papers Published
 



 🤝
 **300\+** 
 Senior Stakeholders Engaged Across Government, Military, Academia, and Civil Society
 



 👥
 **15,000\+** 
 Youth Leaders and Fellows Reached Through Capacity\-Building and Public Engagement
 



 🌐 Strategic Partnerships with Think Tanks, Ministries, Missions, and Universities in India and Abroad
 



  





 Internship Overview
 



 The Research Coordinator Internship is a
 **13\-month, full\-time, in\-person opportunity** 
 based in
 **Noida (Delhi NCR)** 
 . The selected intern will play an active role in GCTC's policy research, conference coordination, stakeholder engagement, and institutional development while working closely with senior government officials, military leaders, diplomats, policymakers, academics, and industry experts.
 



 Outstanding performers will be given preference for suitable full\-time opportunities at GCTC upon successful completion of the internship, subject to organisational requirements.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 Primary Responsibilities
 


* Plan and execute national\-level conferences, seminars, and strategic dialogues on security, defence, governance, public policy, and emerging technologies.
* Liaise with Ministries (MHA, MoD, MEA), senior military officers, diplomats, policymakers, universities, and partner institutions.
* Coordinate speakers, prepare programme material, manage logistics, documentation, and conference execution.



 Research \& Policy
 


* Prepare event reports, policy briefs, strategic papers, concept notes, and background documents.
* Track developments relating to national security, foreign policy, governance, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, and emerging technologies.
* Assist in post\-event reporting, media outreach, and institutional communication.



 Institutional Support
 


* Support research publications, editorial work, and digital campaigns.
* Assist with youth leadership initiatives, capacity\-building programmes, and international collaborations.



 Eligibility \& Qualifications
 



 Applicants should preferably possess:
 


* A Master's degree (completed or final year) in Political Science, International Relations, Strategic Studies, Public Policy, Law, Defence Studies, or a related discipline.
* Excellent research, analytical, communication, and English writing skills.
* Strong organisational and interpersonal skills with the ability to coordinate high\-level programmes.
* Prior internship, research, or event management experience will be an added advantage.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace. Knowledge of Canva or similar design tools is desirable.
* Willingness to work full\-time in person from the GCTC office in Noida.



**Exceptional Candidates:** 
 While preference will be given to applicants pursuing or holding a Master's degree, outstanding candidates with a Bachelor's degree who demonstrate exceptional research aptitude, writing skills, professionalism, leadership potential, and a strong commitment to public policy, governance, and national security may also be considered.
 



  





 What You Will Gain
 


* **Monthly Stipend of ₹10,000\.**
* **Performance\-Based Completion Incentive of up to ₹3,500 per month** 
 , payable as a
 **lump sum upon successful completion of the 13\-month internship** 
 . The incentive will be awarded based on the intern's overall performance, commitment, professionalism, attendance, quality of work, discipline, and contribution to GCTC's programmes and activities. The final incentive amount shall be determined solely at the discretion of GCTC.
* Hands\-on experience in planning and executing prestigious national conferences and strategic dialogues.
* Direct exposure to senior government officials, diplomats, military leaders, policymakers, academics, and industry experts.
* Opportunity to contribute to high\-impact policy research and national\-level initiatives.
* Preference for full\-time opportunities at GCTC upon successful completion of the internship, subject to organisational requirements and performance.
* Certificate of Completion.
* Letter of Recommendation for deserving candidates.



 How to Apply
 



 Please send the following documents to
 **info@gctcworld.org** 
 :
 


* Updated CV
* Statement of Purpose (maximum 250 words)
* Writing Sample (article, policy brief, research paper, or research extract)



**Subject Line:** 




**Application for Research Coordinator Internship – Immediate Joining – \[Your Name]** 




  





 For Queries
 



**Phone:** 
 \+91\-120\-4788620 / \+91\-120\-3111311 / \+91\-120\-3111341
 



**Website:www.gctcworld.org**

title: Meta Ads Operations Executive
description:
**Dominators Business Tribe · Greater Noida West · On\-site · Full\-time** 




  




 About the role
 
 Dominators Business Tribe helps Indian working professionals build and scale digital product businesses. As part of our flagship DBT Accelerator programme, we build and run Meta ad campaigns for our students — real businesses, with real budgets.
 



 We're hiring the person who will run those campaigns.
 



 This is an operations role, not a creative strategy role. You'll work from a documented system with AI\-assisted reporting that handles the heavy analysis. Your job is to execute it accurately across many accounts, make the calls it surfaces, and keep our students informed.
 



**Freshers are welcome.** 
 If you've run even one Meta campaign and you're precise, organised and curious, we will train you on everything else.
 



  




 What you'll do
 
**Daily** 
 — Review the automated performance report across all active accounts. Act on what it flags: pause what isn't working, scale what is, escalate what's broken. Around 30–45 minutes of focused decision\-making.
 



**Weekly** 
 — Send each student a clear performance update. Join the Wednesday coaching call to stay aligned with what our students are learning.
 



**For every new student** 
 — Set up access to their ad account, verify the pixel is firing correctly, build the campaign to our naming convention, and launch it. Around two hours per account.
 



**Always** 
 — Flag problems early. An account heading for trouble at ₹3,000 spent is a conversation; at ₹30,000 it's a refund.
 



 You'll begin with 10–25 accounts and grow as we do, and you'll join our 10:15 AM daily team huddle.
 



  




 What we're looking for
 
**Essential** 



* Basic hands\-on exposure to Meta Ads Manager — a personal campaign, an internship, a college project or a small business all count
* Clear written English; you'll send client updates every week
* Genuinely organised. Managing 25 accounts is a systems problem before it's a marketing problem
* Trustworthy with other people's accounts and budgets
* Comfortable following a documented process — and speaking up when the process is wrong



  





**Good to have** 



* Familiarity with Business Manager, Events Manager or pixel setup
* Exposure to landing pages, checkout tools or funnels
* Interest in digital products, coaching or info\-product businesses
* Comfort using AI tools in daily work



  





**Not required** 
 — a design background, agency experience, or large\-budget campaigns. Ours start at ₹300/day.
 



  




 What we offer
 * **₹20,000 – ₹30,000 per month** 
 , negotiable based on experience
* Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM, on\-site at Greater Noida West
* Structured training on a documented system, with AI tooling that removes the grunt work
* Ownership of a core delivery function with direct access to the founder
* Real campaigns, real budgets, real revenue outcomes — you'll learn more in six months here than in two years of theory

 We at Coforge are hiring for Insurance AI Architect
 



  





**Insurance Industry \& Platform Expertise** 



* **Duck Creek Technologies:** 
 Working knowledge of Duck Creek OnDemand, Duck Creek Policy, Claims, Billing, and Rating modules; understanding of Duck Creek's Author/Manuscript configuration model, Duck Creek Data Insights, and Duck Creek's low\-code/no\-code extensibility framework
* **Optional \- Guidewire InsuranceSuite:** 
 Basic knowledge of PolicyCenter, ClaimCenter, and BillingCenter architecture, including Gosu scripting, PC/CC/BC data model, Integration Gateway, Cloud API, and Guidewire Cloud Platform (GWCP); familiarity with UI framework and Guidewire Marketplace apps

 Experience with how AI services plug into both platforms via REST/SOAP APIs, event\-driven architectures (Guidewire Cloud Events, Duck Creek's integration points), webhooks, and middleware (MuleSoft, Boomi, Azure Integration Services)

 Rating algorithms, forms/endorsements, exposure bases, and how these map into platform data models



  





**AI/ML Technical Stack** 



* **LLM \& GenAI frameworks:** 
 LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel; prompt engineering, RAG architecture design, and agentic frameworks ( CrewAI, or similar) for multi\-step underwriting/claims workflows

 Practical experience with Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Anthropic Claude/API; model selection criteria (cost, latency, accuracy) for insurance\-specific tasks

 Regression, gradient boosting (XGBoost/LightGBM) for risk scoring and pricing models; familiarity with actuarial modeling concepts as they intersect with ML

 OCR and intelligent document processing (Azure Form Recognizer, AWS Textract) for submission intake, ACORD forms, loss runs, and SOV (statement of values) processing a common Commercial/Specialty use case

 Judgment on when to use Copilot Studio (low\-code, business\-user\-facing agents) vs. AI Foundry (custom, code\-first, higher\-control agentic solutions) vs. open\-source/other cloud AI stacks, based on client maturity, governance needs, and use case complexity

 ETL/ELT pipelines pulling from Duck Creek/Guidewire data models into analytics or AI\-ready stores; understanding of insurance data standards (ACORD, ISO)

title: Data Lead
description:
**Who We Are**
 WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40\+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best\-in\-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.
   

  

 The opportunity
   

  

 The Data Lead is responsible for building and governing the data foundation that enables executive visibility across strategic initiatives. This role transforms fragmented business information into trusted portfolio intelligence, ensuring leaders have accurate, timely, and actionable insights to make strategic decisions.
   

  

 What you’ll be doing
   

  

**Develop Enterprise Data Strategy**
* Define and execute the enterprise data strategy supporting portfolio governance, business intelligence and executive decision\-making.
* Build a scalable data architecture that integrates information from multiple sources into a trusted reporting ecosystem.
* Standardize business definitions, KPI methodologies, and data governance across functions.


**Build Portfolio Intelligence**
* Develop portfolio intelligence frameworks, executive dashboards, and scorecards providing visibility into strategic initiatives, financial performance, resource utilization, risks, dependencies, and business outcomes.
* Establish leading indicators that proactively identify execution risks and opportunities.


**Lead Data Governance**
* Define enterprise data governance standards covering ownership, quality, integrity, stewardship, lifecycle management, and reporting controls.
* Continuously improve data quality and governance practices to ensure trusted executive reporting.


**Enable Workforce and Resource Intelligence**
* Build analytical models for workforce planning, capacity forecasting, demand management, resource allocation, utilization, and operational efficiency.
* Partner with PMO, and program manager to optimize workforce investments and support strategic planning.


**Drive Executive Decision Support**
* Translate complex business data into actionable executive insights that support portfolio prioritization, investment decisions, and operational planning.
* Identify trends, risks, dependencies, bottlenecks, and opportunities, providing recommendations that enable proactive decision\-making.


**Partner Across the Enterprise**
* Collaborate with Strategy, Finance, Operations, Technology, Product, Resource Management, and Program teams to align enterprise reporting, analytics, and business metrics.
* Serve as the strategic data partner supporting executive governance and cross\-functional decision making.


**Advance Analytics and AI**
* Partner with data science and engineering teams to develop predictive analytics, forecasting models, scenario planning, and AI enabled insights.
* Evaluate emerging analytics technologies and promote modern data practices that strengthen business intelligence.


**Modernize Reporting and Analytics**
* Design scalable reporting architectures that automate reporting, enable self\-service analytics, and improve executive visibility.
* Standardize dashboards, reporting methodologies, and visualization practices to ensure consistency, accuracy, and timeliness.


**Build Organizational Data Capability**
* Establish repeatable governance frameworks, metadata standards, reporting templates, and documentation that improve organizational data maturity.
* Mentor analysts and promote a culture of data\-driven decision making across the organization.


 What we want from you
   

  

* 10\+ years of progressive experience in Data Strategy, Business Intelligence, Analytics, Business Operations, Portfolio Management, Data Governance, or Management Consulting within a global technology or SaaS organization.
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or a related discipline; Master's degree or MBA preferred.
* Proven experience designing enterprise reporting architectures, executive dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
* Strong expertise in enterprise data governance, master data management, and data quality frameworks.
* Experience supporting executive decision\-making through advanced analytics and strategic reporting.
* Demonstrated success working with Director, VP, and Executive\-level stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of portfolio management, workforce planning, resource management, financial reporting, and business operations.
* Experience with Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, or modern cloud analytics platforms.
* Advanced expertise in Power BI, SQL, Excel, and enterprise visualization tools.
* Experience working with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Workday, SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, ServiceNow, Anaplan, or similar business systems.
* Experience collaborating with Data Engineering and Data Science teams to deliver scalable analytics solutions.
* Working knowledge of AI\-powered analytics, predictive modeling, and modern business intelligence platforms.
* Strong commercial acumen with the ability to translate data into strategic business recommendations.
* Excellent executive communication skills with the ability to simplify complex analytical concepts for senior business leaders.
* Experience leading cross\-functional analytical initiatives within highly matrixed organizations.


 Beyond the Resume
   

  

* Business\-First Mindset: Solves business problems through data, not just reporting.
* Strategic Thinker: Connects data across operations, finance, workforce, and business performance.
* Trusted Advisor: Delivers objective, insight\-driven recommendations that influence executive decisions.
* Builder Mindset: Creates scalable data, governance, and reporting capabilities that endure.
* Analytical Curiosity: Challenges assumptions and uncovers meaningful insights from complex data.
* Executive Storyteller: Translates complex analysis into clear, decision\-ready narratives.
* Collaborative Influencer: Aligns business and technical teams around common goals and standards.
* Innovation\-Driven: Leverages AI and modern analytics to continuously improve business intelligence and decision\-making.


 What we can offer you
   

  

 Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.
   

  

 Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact\-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.
   

  

 We lead with
 **Heart** 
 , fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human\-centric work flourish.
   

  

 We empower your
 **Brains** 
 for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.
   

  

 And we champion
 **Courage** 
 , inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday.
   

  

**About WPP**
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world\-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.
   

  

 WPP (VML/WPP Enterprise Solutions) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Recruitment Privacy Policy. California residents should read our California Recruitment Privacy Notice. **Global Managed Service – Privileged Identity and access Management – Senior**
 The Senior CyberArk Operations Support Analyst is a key member of the CyberArk Privileged Access Management (PAM) team, responsible for the advanced support and management of the CyberArk infrastructure. This role requires a deep understanding of PAM principles, CyberArk architecture, and cybersecurity best practices. The Senior Analyst will lead initiatives to enhance security, streamline processes, and ensure the stability and integrity of privileged account management systems
   

  

**Key Requirements / Responsibilities:**

* Conduct regular system audits to identify potential vulnerabilities and recommend remediation strategies.
* Mentor junior analysts and provide guidance on best practices and technical challenges.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for system configurations, procedures, and service records.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to support enterprise\-wide cybersecurity initiatives and projects.
* Manage the response to critical incidents involving privileged accounts, including root cause analysis and preventive measures.
* Stay abreast of emerging threats and technologies in the PAM space and evaluate their impact on the organization.
* Lead the planning and execution of system upgrades, patches, and maintenance activities, minimizing disruption to business operations.
* Support compliance and regulatory activities by providing expertise and documentation as needed.
* Develop and maintain a comprehensive disaster recovery and business continuity plan for the CyberArk infrastructure, ensuring minimal downtime and quick restoration of services in the event of an outage.
* Collaborate with the cybersecurity architecture team to design and implement a robust privileged access management strategy that aligns with the organization's overall security posture.
* Lead security incident investigations related to privileged accounts, including forensic analysis, and collaborate with the incident response team to develop a coordinated response plan.
* Proactively monitor the CyberArk environment for unusual activities and potential threats using advanced security tools and techniques.
* Serve as the subject matter expert for CyberArk within the organization, providing insights and recommendations to senior management on PAM\-related matters.
* Participate in vendor management, including evaluating potential software solutions, negotiating contracts, and managing relationships with CyberArk and other security vendors.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives by regularly reviewing and updating CyberArk policies and procedures to reflect the evolving threat landscape and business needs.
* Facilitate cross\-training and knowledge sharing sessions within the team to ensure redundancy in critical skill sets and promote a culture of continuous learning.
* Engage with the broader cybersecurity community to stay informed about new vulnerabilities, attack vectors, and defense mechanisms related to privileged access management.
* Influence and enforce security policies and procedures across the organization, ensuring that privileged access is managed in accordance with best practices and regulatory requirements.
* Assist in budget planning and management for the CyberArk operations team, including forecasting future needs for resources, tools, and training.

* Advanced knowledge of CyberArk PAM solutions, with relevant certifications such as CyberArk Certified Delivery Engineer (CDE), Defender, or Sentry.

* Strong understanding of network security, identity and access management (IAM), and related technologies (e.g., SIEM, firewalls, multi\-factor authentication).
* Expertise in scripting and automation to streamline operations and incident response.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Leadership qualities and experience in mentoring or managing junior staff.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey technical information to non\-technical stakeholders


**Education:**
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

**Client Advisory \& Consulting**

* Adobe Experience Cloud certifications (AEP, Analytics, Target, CJA, AJO).

 Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.

 **Heart**

**About Sadhna.co**

* Comfortable communicating with Blinkit ops teams in English and Hindi

* Prior hands\-on experience with Blinkit / Zepto / Instamart / BigBasket seller portals

 Send your CV to bhavya\_chauhan@sadhna.co. In the email, tell us how you'd spend the first Monday morning of this role — what would you check, in what order? That's how we'll know you understand what the role actually is.

title: Disaster Recovery Engineer
description:
* **Disaster Recovery Engineer**
* *Experience: 5\+ years*



 Location \- Remote
 



 Role Overview
 
* The Disaster Recovery Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining Disaster Recovery (DR) solutions to ensure the organization's technology infrastructure and critical systems can withstand and recover from disruptions. This role involves hands\-on work with disaster recovery strategies, high availability (HA) architectures, automation, and failover solutions in on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
* The ideal candidate will have expertise in disaster recovery, IT resilience, and infrastructure engineering, working closely with IT operations, cybersecurity, and business continuity teams to enhance the organization's overall technology resilience posture.


- 


 Key Responsibilities
 

 Disaster Recovery Engineering \& Technology Resilience
 
* • Develop and maintain disaster recovery (DR) solutions, ensuring that IT systems meet defined recovery time objectives (RTO) and recovery point objectives (RPO).
* • Design, implement, and maintain highly available (HA) and fault\-tolerant architectures across on\-premises, cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), and hybrid environments.
* • Implement automation and orchestration for disaster recovery and failover processes using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and scripting tools (Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, Python).
* • Work with IT infrastructure and application teams to integrate resilience best practices into system design, deployment, and operations.
* • Perform failure mode analysis (FMA) to identify and address system vulnerabilities.


- 


 Disaster Recovery Testing \& Validation
 
* • Design and implement fully automated disaster recovery runbooks using Ansible and Python using one\-click or event\-triggered failover systems.
* • Develop automated recovery verification (post\-failover health checks).
* • Develop and execute disaster recovery drills and failover testing, identifying gaps and improvements.
* • Automate DR testing, validation, and reporting.
* • Conduct regular validation of backup and replication strategies, ensuring data integrity and availability.
* • Monitor system failover and recovery performance, optimizing configurations to improve response times.


- 


 Incident Response \& Crisis Management Support
 
* • Act as a technical lead during disruptions and disaster recovery events, ensuring rapid system recovery.
* • Work closely with cybersecurity teams to integrate DR solutions with cyber resilience strategies, ensuring quick restoration from ransomware or cyberattacks.
* • Support post\-incident analysis and recommend improvements to resilience strategies.


- 


 Monitoring, Compliance \& Reporting
 
* • Implement and maintain resilience monitoring tools, ensuring continuous tracking of system availability and DR readiness.
* • Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST, FFIEC, SOC 2\).
* • Provide technical input for audits and regulatory assessments related to technology resilience.
* • Generate reports on resilience testing results, failover performance, and risk mitigation efforts.


- 


 Collaboration \& Training
 
* • Work closely with IT teams, business continuity professionals, and cloud architects to ensure resilience strategies align with business needs.
* • Provide training and technical guidance to IT staff on disaster recovery best practices and system failover configurations.
* • Assist in the development of technical documentation and playbooks for disaster recovery and resilience processes.


- 


 Qualifications \& Experience
 
* • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* • 5\+ years of experience in disaster recovery, resilience engineering, IT infrastructure, or cloud engineering — with disaster recovery as the primary area of focus.
* • Expertise in disaster recovery planning and high\-availability (HA) solution design.
* • Hands\-on experience with backup, replication, and data protection solutions (e.g., Veeam, Commvault, Zerto, Azure Site Recovery).
* • Hands\-on experience with cloud resilience strategies (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud\-native DR tools.
* • Hands\-on experience automating AWS disaster recovery using:
* ○ Boto3 for orchestration of EC2, RDS, S3, Route 53, IAM, AWS Backup, and EDRS.
* ○ Cross\-region replication and failover strategies.
* ○ AWS\-native DR patterns (pilot light, warm standby, multi\-region active/active).
* ○ Automation of AMI lifecycle, backup validation, and restore testing.
* • Advanced automation engineering experience, including:
* ○ Designing and maintaining enterprise\-scale Ansible automation frameworks (roles, collections, dynamic inventories, Ansible Automation Platform/AWX).
* ○ Developing production\-grade Python automation using Boto3\.
* ○ Building event\-driven automation workflows for failover and recovery.
* ○ Implementing idempotent Infrastructure as Code (IaC) patterns.
* ○ Integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins).
* • Knowledge of networking, storage, virtualization, and hybrid\-cloud architectures.
* • Cloud automation and orchestration at scale is a supporting requirement for this position. Candidates must bring demonstrable experience in coding and scripting of cloud resources in AWS and other cloud environments, applied to disaster recovery outcomes.


- 


 Certifications
 
* • Certified Business Continuity Professional (CBCP), or
* • Disaster Recovery Certified Specialist (DRCS)
* • AWS Certified Solutions Architect
* • Red Hat Certified Engineer
* • Microsoft Azure Administrator

title: Academic Advisor
description:
**Company Description** 
 Harwell Global Education is a student\-focused organization dedicated to guiding learners through every stage of their international education journey. The team supports students in selecting suitable courses and universities, preparing strong applications, and navigating scholarship and visa requirements. Harwell also provides study abroad counseling, documentation support, and career\-focused education planning to help students make informed decisions. With an emphasis on upskilling and global career readiness, the organization aims to build students’ knowledge, confidence, and international perspective for the future.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Academic Advisor is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Noida. In this position, the advisor provides one\-on\-one student counseling, helping learners choose appropriate courses, universities, and study destinations aligned with their academic background and career goals. The advisor reviews academic records, explains admission criteria, and guides students through application timelines, documentation, and basic scholarship information. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include conducting advising sessions, maintaining accurate student records, collaborating with colleagues to improve counseling processes, and delivering information sessions or workshops on study abroad options and career pathways. The advisor also supports students in building realistic education plans and encourages informed decision\-making throughout their global education journey.

* Strong student counseling and academic advising skills, with the ability to guide learners through course and university selection.
* Effective communication skills, including clear spoken and written English, and the ability to present complex information in a simple, supportive manner.
* Experience or training in career counseling and education planning, with an understanding of global study options and pathways.
* Knowledge of higher education systems, admission processes, and basic scholarship or funding opportunities in key international destinations.
* Bachelor’s degree in Education, Counseling, Psychology, or a related field; a master’s degree is an advantage.
* Strong organizational and documentation skills, with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple student cases simultaneously.
* Customer\-focused mindset, cultural sensitivity, and a commitment to supporting students from diverse backgrounds.
* Proficiency with standard office software and comfort working with CRM or student management systems.

title: Paid Media (Google Ads)
description:
**Company Description** 
 ROI Mantra is a profit\-focused digital marketing agency and Google All\-Star award winner, with its delivery center based in Noida, India. As a certified Google Premier Partner, the agency specializes in data\-driven strategies that enhance customer acquisition and revenue for clients worldwide. With a team of 100\+ digital experts, ROI Mantra supports direct client projects and provides dedicated offshore resources for businesses and agencies. The company delivers strategic, analytics\-led media executions that drive strong top\-line growth across sectors such as e\-commerce, healthcare, education, NGOs, automotive, and multi\-location businesses. Its services include SEO, PPC, social media marketing and optimization, content writing, web development, and specialized digital marketing solutions for startups and NGOs.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Paid Media (Google Ads) role based at ROI Mantra’s delivery center in Noida (Delhi NCR), India. The Paid Media Specialist will plan, build, and optimize Google Ads campaigns across search, display, shopping, and video to meet performance and ROI targets. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include conducting keyword and audience research, setting up ad groups and targeting, managing budgets and bids, and continuously testing ad creatives and landing pages. The role involves monitoring campaign performance, analyzing data, preparing regular reports, and recommending improvements based on measurable outcomes. Collaboration with internal teams (SEO, content, design, and account management) is key to aligning campaign strategies with client goals and ensuring consistent, high\-quality delivery.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong media planning skills, including budget allocation, forecasting, and performance optimization for Google Ads campaigns.
* Effective communication skills to collaborate with internal teams and present insights and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Solid marketing and new media knowledge, with a clear understanding of digital marketing funnels, PPC strategies, and audience targeting.
* Ability to conduct thorough research on keywords, competitors, and market trends to inform campaign strategy and execution.
* Hands\-on experience managing Google Ads accounts, including search, display, shopping, and remarketing campaigns.
* Proficiency with analytics and reporting tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Data Studio or equivalent dashboards).
* Detail\-oriented approach with strong quantitative and analytical skills, and a focus on achieving performance KPIs.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Google Ads and/or Google Analytics certifications are highly desirable.
* Ability to work on\-site in Noida and thrive in a fast\-paced, data\-driven agency environment.

description:
🎊 We're Hiring — Event Planner \| Premium Celebrations \& Client Servicing
 



 📍 Noida \| Full\-Time \| On\-Site
 



 💼 3–5 Years Experience \| ₹4\.8L – ₹8L CTC
 



  





**DreamLamhe, a unit of Namo Corp Tech Pvt. Ltd., is building a modern celebration management company for weddings, engagements, anniversaries, milestone birthdays, Baby Shower ,corporate gatherings and private premium events.** 




 We are at an important stage of our journey: building our event execution capability, trusted vendor network and a strong portfolio of celebrations before scaling our larger technology\-led vision.
 



 That means we are not looking for someone who simply follows event checklists.
 



 We are looking for someone who takes ownership of the event.
 



 Someone who can sit with a family, understand what they are really trying to create, turn that into a workable plan, coordinate multiple vendors, control timelines and costs, handle last\-minute changes and still make the client feel that everything is under control.
 



  




 What you’ll own
 
  




* Manage clients from the first planning conversation through final event execution.
* Act as the primary point of contact across calls, WhatsApp, meetings and event\-day communication.
* Understand client requirements, budgets, priorities and expectations and convert them into executable event plans.
* Plan weddings, engagements, roka ceremonies, birthdays, anniversaries, pre\-wedding functions, corporate events and private celebrations.
* Source and coordinate decorators, photographers, caterers, DJs, artists, makeup teams, production partners, venues, hospitality teams and other vendors.
* Build detailed event timelines, checklists, budgets, vendor sheets and execution plans.
* Conduct venue visits and coordinate with banquet and hotel teams.
* Negotiate with vendors while maintaining quality and commercial discipline.
* Manage event\-day setup, vendor movement, guest experience, production and troubleshooting.
* Identify risks before they become problems and create backup plans.
* Support the founder in building DreamLamhe’s preferred vendor and venue network.
* Help convert qualified enquiries by understanding what the client needs and presenting the right celebration solution.
* Conduct post\-event reviews so every event improves DreamLamhe’s processes for the next one.



  




 Who we’re looking for
 
  





 You have around
 **3–5 years of hands\-on experience** 
 in wedding planning, event management, luxury hospitality, hotel banquets, client servicing or a closely related role.
 



 You should be comfortable speaking confidently with both clients and vendors in
 **English and Hindi** 
 .
 



 You understand that event management is not a desk\-only job. Site visits, late evenings and weekends are part of the industry, and you are comfortable being present when execution requires it.
 



 More importantly, you are organised without being rigid. When something changes two hours before an event, you don’t panic — you solve it.
 



  




 You’ll stand out if…
 
 You have personally handled weddings or premium social events, managed HNI or demanding family clients, already understand the Delhi NCR vendor and venue ecosystem, have strong commercial negotiation skills, or have experience managing an event from enquiry to final execution.
 



 Existing vendor relationships are valuable, but
 **we are not hiring someone only for their contact book** 
 . We want someone who can help DreamLamhe build a strong, reliable network of its own.
 



  




 What kind of person will succeed here?
 
 Someone who thinks:
 



**“This is my event. I’m responsible for making it work.”** 




**Not:** 




**“That part wasn't assigned to me.”** 




**DreamLamhe is still building, so this role comes with real responsibility and visibility. You will work closely with the leadership team and have the opportunity to help shape how we plan, execute and eventually scale celebrations.** 




**We want someone who wants to build**

title: Content Intern
description:
**About Trackier**
 Trackier is a leading SaaS platform serving businesses across 20\+ countries worldwide. For over a decade, we have empowered brands, advertisers, agencies, and ad networks with innovative Performance Marketing and Mobile Marketing solutions that drive growth and maximize conversions.
   

  

 We empower marketers worldwide with advanced technology and a customer\-first approach. We help businesses build impactful campaigns, create exceptional user experiences, and ensure data privacy. Our smart solutions are designed to optimize marketing strategies, enhance efficiency, and foster long\-term customer relationships based on trust. Trackier was founded to solve a critical challenge—enabling marketers to accurately measure success and build meaningful customer connections.
   

  

 During this six\-month internship, you will work in one of the following areas based on your interests, strengths, and business requirements: LinkedIn Marketing, Meta Marketing, YouTube Marketing, Long\-form Writing, or Technical Writing. You will work closely with the SEO and content teams to research, create, refine, and evaluate content for real business use cases.
   

  

 We are looking for people who are eager to learn, take ownership, and understand the strategy behind the content they create.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Content Research \& Strategy**
* Research topics, audiences, competitors, trends, and market developments to identify content opportunities
* Develop content ideas, hooks, outlines, scripts, posts, articles, and other formats aligned with marketing goals
* Build an understanding of brand voice, positioning, audience behavior, content strategy, and digital distribution
* Support content calendars, campaigns, and content\-led marketing initiatives


**Content Creation \& Distribution**
* Create and refine content for LinkedIn, Meta, YouTube, blogs, articles, technical resources, and other digital channels
* Develop platform\-specific content while maintaining consistent brand voice and messaging
* Repurpose content across formats and channels to maximize reach and engagement
* Support content requirements for marketing, product, sales, and brand initiatives


**Content Performance \& Optimization**
* Monitor content performance across reach, engagement, traffic, and audience response
* Analyze results and use insights to improve topics, formats, messaging, and distribution
* Experiment with different content approaches and stay updated on platform and audience trends


**Collaboration \& AI**
* Collaborate with Marketing, Design, Sales, SEO, and other teams to execute content initiatives
* Use AI and content tools for research, ideation, creation, editing, and workflow improvement
* Maintain content calendars, trackers, and other marketing resources while ensuring quality, accuracy, originality, and brand consistency


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, English, Media, or a related field
* Strong written and spoken English with good research and communication skills
* Genuine interest in content, digital marketing, social media, and emerging trends
* Strong ownership, attention to detail, ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and respond positively to feedback
* Ability to research unfamiliar topics, understand the "why" behind tasks, and learn through experimentation
* Familiarity with tools such as ChatGPT, Canva, Google Analytics, Search Console, Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn, or YouTube Studio is preferred


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience creating blogs, articles, newsletters, technical documentation, scripts, or social media content
* Experience managing a personal LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, newsletter, blog, or other content project
* Basic understanding of SEO, social media analytics, or performance marketing
* Portfolio of published work, college projects, freelance work, or personal projects


**Benefits**
 Gain practical experience in content strategy, audience research, digital distribution, brand communication, and performance measurement through real business projects.
   

  

* Hands\-on exposure to LinkedIn, Meta, YouTube, blogs, and other digital channels
* Experience with modern content, analytics, and AI\-powered tools
* Collaboration with Marketing, Design, Sales, and SEO teams
* Build a portfolio of real\-world, published work
* 5\-day working week in a flexible, remote environment focused on learning, creativity, and professional growth

title: Outreach Manager
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
 



  





 Outreach Manager – Delhi NCR
 



 Amity University
 



  





 Position Overview
 



 Amity University is seeking an energetic, relationship\-driven and results\-oriented Outreach Manager – Delhi NCR to lead and strengthen the University's outreach initiatives across the Delhi\-NCR region. The role will be responsible for building strong relationships with schools, principals, counsellors, educators, education networks and other key stakeholders to enhance Amity University's visibility, engagement and student recruitment pipeline. The ideal candidate will possess excellent communication and networking skills, a strong understanding of the
 



 Delhi\-NCR education ecosystem, and the ability to design and execute high\-impact outreach programs that deliver measurable institutional outcomes.
 



  





 Role Objective
 



 To establish Amity University as a preferred higher\-education partner for schools across Delhi\-NCR by building strong institutional relationships, creating meaningful student engagement opportunities, generating a high\-quality admissions pipeline and delivering measurable outreach outcomes.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. School \& Institutional Outreach
 



 • Develop and maintain strong relationships with schools, school groups, principals, vice principals, career counsellors and senior educators across Delhi\-NCR.
 



 • Identify and establish partnerships with new schools and educational institutions.
 



 • Develop and maintain a structured school engagement and outreach calendar covering the academic year.
 



 • Organize and coordinate school visits, university visits, career sessions, seminars, workshops and interactive student engagements.
 



 • Build long\-term institutional partnerships rather than one\-time engagement opportunities.
 



 2\. Student \& Parent Engagement
 



 • Conduct and coordinate career guidance sessions, university presentations, counselling sessions, webinars and student interaction programs.
 



 • Effectively communicate Amity University's academic programs, career opportunities, campus facilities, international exposure, scholarships and other offerings.
 



 • Engage with prospective students and parents and ensure timely, structured follow\-up.
 



 • Identify high\-potential schools and student segments for focused engagement.
 



 3\. Campus Visit \& Experience Programs
 



 • Drive school and campus visit programs for students and faculty from Delhi\-NCR.
 



 • Coordinate with internal academic and administrative teams to create meaningful and well\-organized campus experiences.
 



 • Develop innovative engagement formats such as Skills of the Future sessions, faculty interactions, laboratory and infrastructure visits, industry interactions, career discovery sessions, innovation and entrepreneurship workshops, student experience programs and academic immersion activities.
 



 4\. Strategic Partnerships
 



 • Build relationships with schools and school chains, education groups, career counsellors, coaching and academic institutions, education associations, student organizations, corporate and industry partners, and relevant government and institutional stakeholders.
 



 • Explore opportunities for MoUs, institutional collaborations, joint events and long\-term engagement programs.
 



 5\. Outreach Campaigns \& Events
 



 • Plan and execute offline and online outreach campaigns across Delhi\-NCR.
 



 • Coordinate participation in education fairs, career fairs, conferences, exhibitions and student events.
 



 • Develop innovative outreach initiatives to increase Amity University's engagement with schools and prospective students.
 



 • Ensure effective branding and professional representation of the University at external events.
 



 6\. Database, Reporting \& Market Intelligence
 



 • Maintain an accurate and updated database of schools, counsellors, principals and key stakeholders across Delhi\-NCR.
 



 • Prepare regular weekly and monthly outreach reports with clear activity, engagement and outcome metrics.
 



 • Analyze school\-wise and area\-wise performance and identify opportunities for growth.
 



 • Monitor competitor universities and emerging trends in the higher\-education market.
 



 7\. Team Coordination
 



 • Coordinate with internal university departments to ensure smooth execution of outreach initiatives.
 



 • Support and mentor outreach executives/coordinators, where applicable.
 



 • Ensure consistent communication and professional representation of Amity University.
 



  





 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 



 • Number of schools actively engaged
 



 • New institutional partnerships established
 



 • School visits and university visits conducted
 



 • Student and parent engagements
 



 • Career counselling and outreach sessions
 



 • Repeat engagements from partner schools
 



 • Strategic collaborations / MoUs
 



 • Outreach coverage across Delhi\-NCR
 



 • Overall contribution to the University's regional outreach strategy
 



  





 Candidate Profile
 



  





 Education
 



 • master's, Marketing, Education, Communications, Management or a related discipline.
 



 • A master's degree / MBA will be an advantage.
 



 Experience
 



 • 4–8 years of experience in education outreach, institutional relations, admissions, business development, school
 



 relations, marketing or a related field.
 



 • Experience working with schools and educational institutions in Delhi\-NCR will be strongly preferred.
 



 • Candidates from universities, higher\-education institutions, education companies or established school networks are encouraged to apply.
 



  





 Required Skills
 



 • Excellent verbal and written communication
 



 • Strong presentation and public\-speaking skills
 



 • Relationship management and networking
 



 • Stakeholder management
 



 • Negotiation and partnership development
 



 • Event planning and execution
 



 • Team coordination
 



 • Strong understanding of the Delhi\-NCR education ecosystem
 



 • Ability to travel extensively across Delhi\-NCR
 



  





 Preferred Attributes
 



 A proactive, target\-oriented and collaborative professional with strong interpersonal skills, commercial awareness, institutional maturity and a genuine interest in building long\-term relationships within the education ecosystem.
 



  





 Travel Requirement
 



 The role requires regular travel across Delhi\-NCR for school visits, institutional meetings, events, campus\-visit coordination and partnership development.
 



  





 Reporting \& Employment Details
 



 Reports To Head – Outreach / Senior Leadership – Outreach \& Admissions
 



 Department \- Outreach / Admissions / Marketing
 



 Location Delhi\-NCR
 



 Employment Type Full\-Time
 



  





 Note: The responsibilities and performance expectations may evolve in line with the University's strategic outreach and
 



 admissions priorities.
